notes.title: v0.02.2691 - Apr 9, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Mercenaries,

We have been working hard on the game and made some serious improvements to the Scan the Freighters mission so that it is both more fun, and more tense. Check it out if you have gone through it already. Along with that there are a bunch of Quality of Life changes to many different parts of the game. Looking forward to feedback and seeing you guys playing.

[h1]Updates to the Tutorial and “Scan the Freighters” Mission[/h1]
[list]
Players will now be required to destroy the mounted laser turrets in “Scan the Freighters” to complete the mission.
Changed VO
Many changes to level for better overall experience
[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
Corrected an issue in the Store that would prevent the BUY button from appearing when selecting items.
Removed the FSM converter (For Now)
New UI sounds
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations, Improvements, and Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
Database optimizations for cleaner and more responsive pilot terminal
Various visual and gameplay optimizations
Audio Bugs and cracks removed or fixed
New Explosion sounds
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
Certification point requirements have been adjusted to be easier to earn
Rewards give the correct amounts now
Rewards have been adjusted to give out credits correctly more consistently
Removed the Dev Console
[/list]

notes.title: v0.02.2641 - Mar 26, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Mercenaries,

We have a pretty big update coming out today and we are excited to see what you guys think. We are releasing the pilot terminal. This is a pretty big update as the Pilot Terminal contains pilot progression and ship customizations. This means that we are going to reset your accounts and let you start earning your ships. The terminal is in no way finished, and will undergo a lot of changes and tweaks as we continue to improve it. The current progression system is tuned to be on the short side. Progression is intended to be slow, but for alpha we reduced requirements to make sure you guys can get to content. We will also be looking out for your feedback to make sure it’s fun, and not a chore.

There are currently no plans for a premium account system so we want your progress to feel rewarding for its difficulty and skill expression, and not like a grind of epic proportions. Costs of ships and weapons is something else we are looking at, and may change if they are just too daunting with a lower player base. When we bring in the rest of the KS backers we will evaluate and modify then to try and get the progression to feel good with more games being played. As a heads up your account may be reset several times during the testing process.

We have made a video that goes over the pilot terminal in detail and explains how to navigate and use it so that you can actually play the game. The in game tutorial for the pilot terminal is something we are going to add, but not soon. So please watch the video first.

[h1]The Pilot Terminal[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Pilot Terminal is now available for pilots to access in the hangar! The following features are now enabled for all players and are interacted with via this new interface.
[list]
[*]Pilot Certification System: Players can now experience progression by unlocking improved ships and equipment through the Certification system. 
[*]Store: Purchase new ships, equipment, fabrication licenses and ship-specific skins using currency earned from completing Contracts.
[*]Fabrication and Licenses: Using fabrication stock material (FSM) earned from completing contracts, players can construct desired ships and equipment through the Fabricator. An appropriate License will need to be earned and purchased from the Store for each type of constructed item.
[*]Ship Customization: Players can now edit the loadouts and weapon groups of their ships and equip skins purchased from the Store.
[*]Pilot Statistics: Allows players to review previous match results, Certification progress and other pilot-specific information.
[/list]
[*]Some features in the Pilot Terminal may not be fully enabled and will be iterated upon as development continues. Please keep in mind the newly-implemented [i][u]progression system is subject to change[/u][/i] and as the Alpha stage of development continues, player progression may be completely reset if necessary. This will be clearly communicated if and when it occurs in future updates.
[*]For more information about the features of the new Pilot Terminal and the Certification system, there will be a tutorial video posted in the very near future. [url=https://youtu.be/oqyOdfzc8Rc]For now here is an overview.[/url] 
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that was intermittently occurring when shooting missiles at reactors on the Atlas and Lethe base.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.01.2545 - Mar 5, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Mercenaries,

Please find below the latest Alpha Patch Notes.

[h1]Gameplay / Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Targeting markers now appear on objectives such as the reactors, enabling them to be locked on.
[*]The health of the Lethe base and Atlas reactors have been increased to extend the length of matches.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]When a contract is launched, it will now not start until the host clicks the Launch button, or the match meets the maximum number of participants.
[*]When selecting a contract, host can now limit the number of maximum participants.
[*]The current player maximum has temporarily been set to four for stability until the module system improvements are complete.
[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented a preview of the new Input system and related menu in Settings. Keep in mind that this system is very much under active development and currently does not function correctly.
[*]The in-cockpit Multi-Function Display behavior has been improved to be more responsive
[*]Joystick inputs have had a cap put on the axes to better reflect user input.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Clicking the “X” in the Inputs settings will delete that input from your list. Delete the /Starfighter/Saved/Config/WindowsNoEditor/Input.ini file to restore defaults if this occurs.
[*]Missile targeting icons do not always appear.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.01.2459 - Feb 19, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Mercenaries, 

We are excited to announce the first patch of the Alpha. We love all the feedback we have been getting and want to use it to make chances that improve the game so that you guys all enjoy it as much as we do. We tackled just a few things in this patch while we look to improve and implement the rest of the core of the game. There are many more fixes and tweaks on their way, but at least you won't bounce off of solid objects when flying at high speeds.

Cannot wait to see you all out there!


[h1]Gameplay / Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Impact Damage
Impact and collision damage have been reworked; they should now properly take kinetic energy into consideration. Collisions when reversing should also be improved. Mass/ratio logic should be improved and minimum collision velocity to deal damage to vehicles has been raised to 10 m/s.
[*]Flip and Burn
Updated logic for each ship's "flip and burn" maneuver, it should only fire main engines when ship's forward vector is less than 45 degrees from retrograde vector. The Pegasus and Hyperion ships should now flip and burn reliably.
[*]Matches should properly end when all players on one team are killed and/or their ship is destroyed
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Contracts that players are unable to join should no longer appear in the Contract Portal
[/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]The post-match scoreboard should now appear correctly
[*]EMP status of your target is now displayed on your HUD
[*]The Multi-function Display should more reliably display module status
[*]The Drone Camera interface should no longer block mouse input
[*]Improved graphics information and audio slider sizes in Settings
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased volume of voice over audio during the tutorial mission, it should now be easily heard over ship sound effects
[/list]
